name: stripe-billing
description: Stripe subscription billing for a SaaS: Checkout, Customer Portal and webhooks that stay correct under retries, duplicates and out-of-order delivery.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,stripe -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run listen -w server"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
